title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Batac General Hospital in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Batac General Hospital in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Đa khoa Batac tại Đô thị Batac, Tỉnh Ilocos Norte, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลทั่วไป Batac ในเทศบาล Batac จังหวัด Ilocos Norte และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Umum Batac di Kotamadya Batac, Provinsi Ilocos Norte, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Besar Batac di Perbandaran Batac, Wilayah Ilocos Norte, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6188_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Batac General Hospital in the Municipality of Batac, Province of IIocos Norte, is hereby increased from fifty beds to one hundred beds.

Such sums as may be needed for the operation of the additional facilities shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act: Provided, That no portion of the appropriation shall be transferred.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
